items.summary: Amendment 86, brought by Colorado conservatives and backed by national Republicans, would have required public input and a court review of any mid-decade congressional redistricting in the state

items.title: Voters reject ballot measure capping Colorado’s income tax rate at 4.4%
items.summary: Proposition 136, brought by conservative activists, would have capped the state income tax rate at its current level in a bid to thwart the tax hikes of Amendment 87
